memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way of death." — Proverbs 14:12

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Speed is a virtue only when you are headed in the right direction. We live in a world obsessed with "fast-tracking" success, yet we rarely pause to check the map. As the tragic story of the GPS-led bridge accident reminds us, absolute trust in a flawed system leads to catastrophe. It doesn’t matter how powerful the engine is or how fast the driver accelerates; if the path is wrong, every mile covered only increases the distance between the traveler and their true destination.

In our spiritual lives, we often rely on "earthly GPS" popular opinion, personal feelings, or cultural trends. These systems are prone to glitches and outdated information. They might lead us toward a "bridge" that no longer exists, promising a shortcut that ends in a fall.

Jesus declared, "I am the Way." He is not a map you study, but a Person you follow. To ensure we stay on the path, God has provided the Holy Spirit as our Divine GPS. Unlike technology, this heavenly guidance system is never offline, never outdated, and never fails to account for the hazards ahead. When we feel pulled away by the currents of life, we must recalibrate by listening to the Spirit’s voice.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "If you are on the wrong road, progress means doing an about-turn and walking back to the right road; and in that case, the man who turns back soonest is the most progressive man." — C.S. Lewis

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Heavenly Father, I thank You that You have not left me to wander aimlessly. Forgive me for the times I have prioritized speed over direction. Holy Spirit, I submit to Your divine guidance today. Be my GPS ! alert me when I am drifting and lead me back to the Narrow Way. I trust Your navigation over my own understanding. Protect my steps from the broken bridges of this world. In Jesus' name, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Checking your direction is more important than checking your speed. If you feel a tug of unease in your spirit today, stop and recalibrate. It is better to stand still on the right path than to run full tilt toward a dead end. Let the Holy Spirit guide your decisions today; He knows the way through the fog.
